description_en: Deletes a subinterface from a leased line port
kebab_example: aliyun smartag delete-sag-express-connect-interface --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --port-name 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSagExpressConnectInterface

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en: The name of the leased line port
parameters.name: port_name

parameters.help_en:
The VLAN ID of the leased line port.

Valid values: 0 to 4094.


If the VLAN ID is 0, the leased line port is a physical port and does not support VLAN interfaces.
If the VLAN ID is 1 to 4094, the leased line port supports VLAN interfaces based on the Layer-3 protocols
parameters.help_zh:
专线子接口所属VLAN编码。

取值范围：0~4094。

VLAN编码为0时，代表此端口为物理端口，不使用VLAN子接口模式。
VLAN编码为1~4094时，代表此端口使用基于VLAN的三层子接口
parameters.name: vlan
